nodes.speaker: psy
nodes.text: Halfway there. The crew is homesick, and Earth is just a bright blue dot.

variants.text: Halfway there. The crew is homesick and wants another movie night like the one on the way here.
Halfway there. The crew is homesick, and our weak antenna makes calls to Earth crackly.

nodes.fact: Astronauts on long missions get homesick. Calls with family, hobbies and surprise packages from Earth help.

nodes.speaker: hq
nodes.text: The rotation lander is scheduled for Day 84! Prep the base for the new crew, or squeeze in one more experiment?
nodes.fact: On the space station, crews hand over in person at every rotation, just like handing over a home.
